Game Overview

In Doc Darling Santa Surgery, the core idea is straightforward: help Santa recover in time for Christmas by fixing his sleigh, reuniting with reindeer, and tending his injuries. Under Doc Darling's guidance, perform surgery and prepare him for his yuletide mission. Quick thinking and attention to detail are key as you ensure Santa’s back on his merry way!
